pick.headline: Gorbachev resigns as Soviet president
pick.summary: On December 25, 1991, Mikhail Gorbachev resigned as President of the USSR in a televised address, and the Soviet flag was lowered over the Kremlin.
pick.significance: The end of the Soviet Union closed the Cold War.
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of December 26, 1991, carried Moscow INTERFAX in English: an hour and a half before resigning, Gorbachev phoned Bush urging support for the Commonwealth and Russia, and spoke with Genscher.

alternates.headline: Nicolae and Elena Ceausescu tried and executed
alternates.summary: On December 25, 1989, Nicolae and Elena Ceausescu were tried by a hastily convened military tribunal at Targoviste and shot.
alternates.significance: Their execution was meant to end Securitate resistance; footage was shown on Romanian television the next day.
alternates.fbis: The East Europe Daily Report of December 26, 1989, carried Bucharest Domestic Service announcing the Ceausescus' arrest, military tribunal, death sentence and execution, and Belgrade TANJUG on television showing them beforehand.
